items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: Willie, the old man. The old man. Played clarinet. Well, he was the band leader on that show.

ctx.x: Willie, the old man. The old man. Played clarinet. Well, he was the band leader on that show. On this carnival. On this carnival. That's right.
I didn't know. We talked to him once after he had a stroke and he couldn't tell us very much. His memory wasn't really good then. Yeah, he was the band leader. He was very old.
